# Rajeev Freelancer

> Rajeev is a senior freelance engineer and AI / digital-marketing consultant with 12+ years of experience (ex-IOG, Accenture, Google). He builds websites and custom software, and runs SEO, digital marketing, GEO (AI-search optimization), AI automation, and WhatsApp/SMS marketing for founders and businesses in 27+ countries. Communication is fast, usually over WhatsApp, and every engagement is delivered personally — no account managers or offshore relays.

## Key facts
- Name: Rajeev (Rajeev Freelancer)
- Role: Senior Freelance Engineer & AI / Digital Marketing Consultant
- Experience: 12+ years in production; 180+ projects delivered; 27+ countries served
- Based in: Gurgaon, India — available worldwide, remote
- Contact: hello@rajeevfreelancer.com · WhatsApp +91 97116 23561
- Free consultation, typically replies within the hour

## Services
- [Freelance AI Consultant](https://rajeevfreelancer.com/freelance-ai-consultant): AI automation, chatbots, agents and workflow integrations.
- [Freelance Digital Marketing Consultant](https://rajeevfreelancer.com/freelance-digital-marketing-consultant): Paid, organic and lifecycle growth engineered around revenue.
- [Freelance SEO Expert](https://rajeevfreelancer.com/freelance-seo-expert): Technical + content SEO and GEO that compound into rankings and AI citations.
- [Freelance Website Developer](https://rajeevfreelancer.com/freelance-website-developer): WordPress and custom web apps built for speed and conversion.
- [Freelance App Developer](https://rajeevfreelancer.com/freelance-app-developer): iOS, Android and cross-platform mobile apps.
- [Freelance Software Developer](https://rajeevfreelancer.com/freelance-software-developer): Custom applications and production-grade software engineering.
- [WhatsApp Marketing Freelancer](https://rajeevfreelancer.com/whatsapp-marketing-freelancer): Campaigns, auto-replies, chatbots and lead nurturing.
- [SMS Marketing Freelancer](https://rajeevfreelancer.com/sms-marketing-freelancer): Bulk SMS campaigns, OTP flows and automated journeys.
